panel.summary: `touchUpdatedAt` rejection escapes the handler, contradicting the documented/asserted "always 200" contract
panel.evidence: `await this.documentService.touchUpdatedAt(parsed.id, at);` is not wrapped; a Prisma/DB error (connection loss, deadlock) propagates and Nest returns 500. The class doc comment and yorkie-event.controller.spec.ts:66 ("always answers ok so Yorkie does not retry") state the endpoint always answers ok — the test only covers the early-return branch, so the contract is unenforced on the one path that can actually throw. Whether retrying on a DB error is desirable or not, the code and its stated contract disagree, and the failure is also unlogged here.
